title: Instrumentation cohesion and dependency spring-clean for perf/test harness
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Why: Over time the benchmarking and eval harness has accreted duplicated instrumentation, several out-of-date client libs, and a few home-grown metric naming conventions. This makes perf regressions noisy to diagnose, increases cost due to redundant metrics/kvs, and slows down small change rollouts because tests flake depending on slightly different dependency stacks.

Goal: Reduce noise and tech debt across the loadgen, scenario driver, and eval-orchestrator so that a perf run produces consistent traces/metrics and maintenance/upgrades are straightforward. Deliver a small scoped refactor that unifies instrumentation conventions, upgrades critical client libs to supported versions, and removes one legacy forked dependency.

Scope (what's in):
- Unify metric and trace naming across three harness components: loadgen (go), scenario-driver (node), eval-orchestrator (python). Produce a short naming doc.
- Upgrade Prometheus client libs (go prometheus v1.15 -> v1.18; node prom-client 14.x -> 16.x; python prometheus-client 0.11 -> 0.15) and fix breaking changes.
- Replace forked-json-serializer (internal fork) with upstream bump and adapter shim for backward compatibility.
- Standardize CI test reporters (junit XML) to feed into the regression dashboard and reduce flaky parsing.
- Add lightweight end-to-end smoke job in CI that validates the unified metrics pipeline emits expected labels.

Scope (out of):
- Large runtime kernel optimizations, batching changes, or architectural changes to eval-orchestrator. Those remain for follow-ups.

Acceptance criteria:
1) Single short doc (CONFLUENCE) describing metric/trace canonical names and tag set is published and linked from the harness README.
2) All three harness components use the published naming conventions for new spans/metrics. Existing runs in perf dashboard show fewer duplicate series.
3) Prometheus client upgrades applied with CI green and no metric regressions seen on a smoke run.
4) Legacy fork removed behind a compatibility shim, PR merged and release cut.
5) One new CI smoke job exists that fails if expected labels/spans are missing.

Rollout plan:
- Week 1: Draft naming doc; run dependency scan; identify breaking changes.
- Week 2: Implement instrumentation adapter in loadgen and scenario-driver; open PRs for prometheus client upgrades.
- Week 3: Merge PRs, run extended smoke and manual perf run against staging; monitor dashboard for duplicate series drop.
- Post-merge: Cut patch release and notify teams via #perf and release notes.

Risks and mitigations:
- Upgrading prometheus clients may change histogram buckets/label cardinality; mitigation: run upgrade in canary branch and compare series count before merging.
- Replacing forked serializer could change line protocol. Mitigation: include adapter shim and explicit parsing tests.
- CI flakes on XML parsing. Mitigation: add robust parsing tests and fail CI loudly if reporter output schema changes.
